newsitem.title: USA: Carriage Services names Livengood CFO.
newsitem.headline: Carriage Services names Livengood CFO.

text.p: Carriage Services Inc said Friday that it had named Thomas Livengood as its chief financial officer.
Livengood was formerly the chief financial officer at Tenneco Energy, a division of Tenneco Inc.

Livengood succeeds Mark Duffey, who is now president. The previous president, Melvin Payne, is now the chairman and chief executive, and Byron Snyder, the previous chairman, is now chairman of the Executive Committee of the company's board, Carriage Services said.
